mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.tenant_id, i.dict_type_id, i.option_code, i.option_label, i.sort_no, i.status, i.created_at, i.updated_at, i.version FROM sys_dictionary_item i INNER JOIN sys_dictionary_type t ON t.id = i.dict_type_id AND t.tenant_id = i.tenant_id WHERE i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.dict_code = #{dictCode} AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND i.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY i.sort_no ASC, i.id ASC
SELECT id, tenant_id, dict_code, dict_name, status, created_at, updated_at, version FROM sys_dictionary_type WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, tenant_id, dict_type_id, option_code, option_label, sort_no, status, created_at, updated_at, version FROM sys_dictionary_item WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY dict_type_id ASC, sort_no ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, tenant_id, dict_type_id, option_code, option_label, sort_no, status, created_at, updated_at, version FROM sys_dictionary_item WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_dictionary_item WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dict_type_id = #{dictTypeId} AND option_code = #{optionCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_dictionary_item (tenant_id, dict_type_id, option_code, option_label, sort_no, status) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{dictTypeId}, #{optionCode}, #{optionLabel}, #{sortNo}, #{status})
